item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00023","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C03","C14","C11"],"selected_candidate_label":"C03","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C03 is a clear material drafting template for the 1958 proclamation. The child repeats its core operative call almost verbatim with only the observance date changed, and closely reuses its distinctive year-round appeal linking public assistance to handicapped persons' economic independence and active participation. The shared sequence—employment and dignity predicates, congressional authorization, annual observance call, then a year-round appeal—is also strongly parallel. C14 and C11 are secondary because they contain closely related annual-observance language and the list of officials and organizational leaders urged to participate, but neither matches the child's concluding appeal as closely as C03.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"do call upon the people of our Nation to observe the week beginning October 5, 1958, as National Employ the Physically Handicapped Week","parent_excerpt":"do call upon the people of our Nation to observe the week beginning October 6, 1957, as National Employ the Physically Handicapped Week","explanation":"The central operative sentence is virtually identical, with only the annual date changed."},{"child_excerpt":"I request our citizens to remember, throughout the year, that by their interest and assistance many handicapped persons can achieve economic independence and active participation in the total life of the national community","parent_excerpt":"I also urge our citizens to remember, throughout the year, that by their interest and efforts many handicapped persons can be assisted to economic Independence and active participation in our productive way of life","explanation":"This is distinctive shared language and substantive machinery: a year-round appeal, public interest or assistance, economic independence, and active participation."},{"child_excerpt":"Whereas with respect for the God-given dignity of each individual ... we appreciate the importance of useful employment","parent_excerpt":"Whereas equal opportunity for employment is basic to our belief in human dignity","explanation":"The child adapts C03's opening linkage between human dignity and employment opportunity."}]}
